command:
cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

txt = open('/app/meeting_scheduled.ics').read()
lines = [l.strip() for l in txt.splitlines() if l.strip()]
print("starts BEGIN:VCALENDAR:", lines[0] == "BEGIN:VCALENDAR")
print("ends END:VCALENDAR:", lines[-1] == "END:VCALENDAR")
print("VERSION:2.0:", "VERSION:2.0" in lines)
print("PRODID:", any(l.startswith("PRODID:") for l in lines))
for a in ["alice@example.com","bob@example.com","carol@example.com"]:
    print("attendee", a, ":", a in txt)
print("summary:", "SUMMARY:Team Planning Meeting" in txt)

ds = re.search(r"DTSTART:(\d{8}T\d{6}Z)", txt).group(1)
de = re.search(r"DTEND:(\d{8}T\d{6}Z)", txt).group(1)
s = datetime.strptime(ds, "%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
e = datetime.strptime(de, "%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
print("slot:", s, "->", e, "duration hours:", (e-s).total_seconds()/3600)
assert e - s == timedelta(hours=1)
assert 9 <= s.hour and (e.hour < 18 or (e.hour == 18 and e.minute == 0))
assert s.weekday() < 5

def parse(p):
    b=[]; st=None
    for l in open(p):
        l=l.strip()
        if l.startswith("DTSTART:"): st=datetime.strptime(l[8:],"%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
        elif l.startswith("DTEND:"): b.append((st,datetime.strptime(l[6:],"%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")))
    return b

cals={"alice":parse('/app/alice_calendar.ics'),"bob":parse('/app/bob_calendar.ics'),"carol":parse('/app/carol_calendar.ics')}
for n,c in cals.items():
    for bs,be in c:
        assert not (s < be and bs < e), f"CONFLICT {n} {bs} {be}"
    print(n,"no conflict OK")

# per-person availability
assert s.hour >= 9 and e.hour <= 14, "alice hours"
assert s.hour >= 10
if s.weekday() in (1,3): assert e <= s.replace(hour=16,minute=30)
assert not (s.hour == 12 and s.minute < 30), "carol lunch"
assert s.weekday() != 0, "prefers non-Monday"
print("ALL CONSTRAINT CHECKS PASSED")
EOF
echo "--- inputs unchanged (sha) ---"
md5sum /app/alice_calendar.ics /app/bob_calendar.ics /app/carol_calendar.ics
echo "--- final file ---"
cat /app/meeting_scheduled.ics
